{
  "verdict": "fix",
  "issues": [
    "The POST /v1/tasks request_body references the full Task schema, which incorrectly requires clients to provide server-managed fields (id, created_at, updated_at).",
    "The PATCH /v1/tasks/{id} request_body duplicates the status enum and property definitions inline instead of referencing the shared Task schema, risking schema drift.",
    "The GET /v1/tasks endpoint lacks query parameter definitions for pagination or filtering, making it impractical for production use as data scales.",
    "Path parameters ({id}) are not defined with type or format constraints in the endpoint definitions, leaving URI validation rules ambiguous."
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Create a separate CreateTask schema for the POST request_body that excludes id, created_at, and updated_at from the required array.",
    "Refactor the PATCH request_body to use $ref or allOf with the Task schema, explicitly setting required to an empty array or listing only mutable fields.",
    "Add a query_parameters object to the GET /v1/tasks endpoint defining pagination (e.g., limit, offset) and filtering (e.g., status) options.",
    "Define path parameter schemas (e.g., type: string, format: uuid) within each endpoint to enforce consistent URI validation."
  ]
}
